description: The organization lacks a process for conducting post-incident reviews and lessons learned activities. This signal indicates that the organization does not systematically review and document lessons learned from security incidents. Without a formal post-incident review process, the organization cannot identify root causes, improve response capabilities, or prevent similar incidents from recurring. This represents a missed opportunity for continuous improvement of security posture.
applicability: This signal applies to: Enterprise incident response programs Security operations center (SOC) operations Computer security incident response team (CSIRT) activities Continuous improvement initiatives Risk management processes Security control enhancement Organizational learning programs

metadata.detection_notes: Review CIS compliance documentation and controls for INCIDENT requirements.
